articles.title: JOSHCO: social and affordable housing in Johannesburg
articles.summary: The Johannesburg Social Housing Company develops and manages social and affordable rental housing, helping people live close to work in the city.
articles.subject: housing

articles.title: The Joburg Property Company: managing the city property estate
articles.summary: The Joburg Property Company manages the City of Johannesburg municipal property portfolio, including property development, leasing and facilities management.
articles.subject: property

articles.title: Joburg Market: largest fresh produce market in Africa
articles.summary: The Joburg Market at City Deep trades fresh fruit and vegetables and serves as the largest fresh produce market in Africa.
articles.subject: food security

articles.title: Johannesburg City Parks and Zoo: public open space management
articles.summary: Johannesburg City Parks and Zoo manages the city parks, cemeteries, public open spaces, street trees, botanical gardens and the Johannesburg Zoo.
articles.subject: parks and recreation

articles.title: The Johannesburg Development Agency: urban infrastructure delivery
articles.summary: The Johannesburg Development Agency plans and implements area-based infrastructure and urban development projects on behalf of the City of Johannesburg.
articles.subject: urban development

articles.title: MTC: the City broadband and technology company
articles.summary: The Metropolitan Trading Company supplies wholesale data, dark fibre, lit fibre and connectivity services as the City of Johannesburg broadband and technology company.
articles.subject: connectivity

articles.title: Joburg Tourism: destination marketing for the City
articles.summary: The Joburg Tourism Company is the destination management organisation selling the City of Johannesburg to leisure, business and events visitors.
articles.subject: tourism

articles.title: Joburg City Theatres: the city major theatre venues
articles.summary: Joburg City Theatres operates the Joburg Theatre, Soweto Theatre and Roodepoort Theatre, the City of Johannesburg major performance venues.
articles.subject: arts and culture

articles.title: Metrobus: municipal bus services in Johannesburg
articles.summary: Metrobus operates scheduled municipal bus services across the City of Johannesburg as part of the city public transport network.
articles.subject: public transport

articles.title: Pikitup: waste management for the City
articles.summary: Pikitup is the City of Johannesburg waste management utility, responsible for refuse collection, recycling and disposal services.
articles.subject: waste management

articles.title: City Power: electricity supply and distribution
articles.summary: City Power supplies and distributes electricity in the City of Johannesburg, including connections, metering and outage management.
articles.subject: electricity

articles.title: Johannesburg Water: water supply and sanitation
articles.summary: Johannesburg Water supplies potable water and manages sanitation services across the City of Johannesburg.
articles.subject: water and sanitation

articles.title: The Johannesburg Roads Agency: roads and stormwater
articles.summary: The Johannesburg Roads Agency plans, builds and maintains the City of Johannesburg road network and stormwater infrastructure.
articles.subject: roads and infrastructure

articles.title: Human settlements: housing delivery in Johannesburg
articles.summary: The human settlements directorate of the City of Johannesburg drives housing delivery, title deeds and informal settlement upgrades.
articles.subject: housing

articles.title: Public safety services in the City of Johannesburg
articles.summary: Public safety in the City of Johannesburg covers by-law enforcement, law enforcement support and emergency management.
articles.subject: public safety

articles.title: Economic development in the City of Johannesburg
articles.summary: The economic development directorate promotes job creation, business support and investment in the City of Johannesburg.
articles.subject: economic development
